content.user_title: Review Backend APIs for Production Readiness
content.value_statement: Backend reviews often miss API contract issues, unsafe error handling, and tangled route logic. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused backend review checklists.
actual_capabilities: Reviews API routes for REST naming, HTTP verbs, versioning, and status code choices.
Checks separation between routes, controllers, services, models, and repositories.
Prompts review of input validation, authentication, authorization, and rate limiting.
Highlights backend anti-patterns including fat routes, direct request body use, leaked error details, and missing pagination.
Provides HTTP status code and architecture layer references for code review conversations.
limitations: Does not run tests, execute code, or inspect behavior outside provided files.
Focuses on review guidance, not framework-specific implementation details.
Examples are Node.js oriented, so other stacks may need adaptation.
Does not replace a full security assessment or threat model.

use_cases.title: Mentor Backend Reviews
use_cases.description: Guide junior engineers through API design, validation, error handling, and architecture questions during review.

use_cases.title: Audit Express Endpoints
use_cases.description: Check Express or Node.js routes for REST conventions, middleware placement, status codes, and route bloat.

use_cases.title: Plan Service Refactors
use_cases.description: Identify misplaced business logic, data access leaks, and controller responsibilities before restructuring a backend module.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Route
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this backend route with the backend fundamentals checklist. Focus on REST naming, status codes, validation, and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Check Layer Boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these backend files for separation of concerns. Identify route, controller, service, repository, and model boundary issues.

prompt_templates.title: Review Backend Security
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this API flow for validation, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and leaked internal errors. Ask Socratic questions for each concern.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Refactor Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this backend module and propose a staged refactor plan. Preserve behavior while improving layers, testability, and API contracts.

output_examples.input: A POST user endpoint mixes validation, database access, and response formatting in one route.
output: Route responsibilities are too broad; move business logic into a controller or service.
Validate request body fields before data access.
Return explicit created or validation responses with appropriate status codes.

output_examples.input: A list endpoint returns all records and exposes raw database errors.
output: Add pagination before the endpoint reaches production scale.
Hide internal error messages from clients and log context server side.
Use a standard server error response for unexpected failures.

output_examples.input: An update endpoint checks login status but not resource ownership.
output: Authentication exists, but authorization is incomplete.
Confirm the caller owns the resource or has an allowed role.
Add tests for cross-user access attempts.

best_practices: Share relevant route, middleware, service, and model files together for boundary review.
Ask for concrete review findings with severity, rationale, and suggested next steps.
Include expected API behavior and user roles when reviewing authorization paths.
anti_patterns: Asking for a complete rewrite before identifying specific backend review risks.
Reviewing isolated snippets without route context, middleware chain, or data access details.
Treating the checklist as a replacement for tests, threat modeling, or production observability.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews API design, route structure, middleware usage, backend layering, validation, authorization, and error handling.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is prepared for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it execute backend commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is Markdown guidance and does not request command execution.

faq.question: Can it find security issues?
faq.answer: It helps identify review concerns like missing validation, weak authorization, rate limiting gaps, and leaked internal errors.

faq.question: Is it only for Express?
faq.answer: No. The examples use Express style, but the review principles apply to many HTTP backend frameworks.

faq.question: What should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide routes, middleware, controllers, services, models, expected behavior, and relevant user roles.
